ops.oldText: Any such audit shall be permitted by Licensee within 30 days of Licensee's receipt of a written request of Licensor.
ops.newText: Any such audit shall be permitted by Licensee, no more than once per 12 months, within 30 days of Licensee's receipt of a written request of Licensor.

ops.text: No audit shall be conducted except on not less than 30 days' prior written notice, during business hours, off-site where possible, by an auditor bound by confidentiality obligations, and no audit shall include direct access to Licensee's systems.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We capped audits at no more than once per 12 months in the operative sentence and added one short sentence requiring 30 days' prior written notice, business-hours and off-site conduct, a confidentiality-bound auditor and no access to our systems, per our audit position. The mutual-agreement auditor selection, the 30-day accommodation mechanic and the Licensor-borne cost (absent a 5% discrepancy) are unchanged.
proposal.summary: Cap audits at once per 12 months on 30 days' prior written notice, business hours, off-site, confidential auditor, no system access

mappings.element: No more than one audit per 12 months.

mappings.quote: Licensee agrees to allow an independent Certified Public Accountant or other Audit Professional, (selected by mutual agreement) to audit and analyze appropriate accounting records

mappings.element: Audit at Vendor's cost unless underpayment exceeds 5%.
mappings.quote: The cost of the audit will be borne by Licensor unless a discrepancy of more than five-percent (5%) is discovered

mappings.element: No direct access to Customer systems.
